subject: SecurityPkg/Tcg2Smm: harden NVS/SMI state initialization
reasons: Multiple distinct changes: initializing globals to MAX_UINTN, adding a NULL guard check in a callback, and reinitializing locals in a function
Each change addresses a different concern (state hardening) and requires case-by-case reasoning about what sentinel value is appropriate
No single uniform structural pattern that Coccinelle could express as a SmPL rule
